review.method: Pinned bytes, ZIP/XML cached cells, source header checks, row-count and identity audit.

sourcePolicy.cutoffMeaning: Analyst-selected voltage cutoff, not an alarm threshold.
sourcePolicy.denominator: Percentages use only finite selected-channel readings among the selected rows.
sourcePolicy.rowMeaning: Source records include repeated aging readings and shared specimens, apparatus and calibration; they are not independent trials.
sourcePolicy.zeroMeaning: A finite cached zero stays zero; it does not establish an enabled sensor, zero smoke, or nondetection.
sourcePolicy.missingMeaning: Blank, error and non-numeric source values are retained and excluded from the finite denominator; no gap filling.
sourcePolicy.channelMeaning: All selectable channels are volts. Obscuration volts are not percent obscuration; ion delta is not a detector alarm.
sourcePolicy.filterMeaning: Flight and material selection does not validate instrument operation. Recorded use/quality fields remain attached to rows.
sourcePolicy.sourceScope: Material Sort flight markers 1/2 only; ground records and other worksheets are not silently pooled.
sourcePolicy.referenceMeaning: DBP is a reference material and is excluded by the default selection; 20 rows are available explicitly.

identityConflicts.statement: The 109-row SAME-R condition table and 109 flight-2 workbook records have different material/test identities. No automatic crosswalk, correction, deletion or row filling is applied.

recipe.cutoffMeaning: Analyst cutoff only; not an alarm threshold.
recipe.axisPolicy: Fixed from the complete non-reference source population, independent of material visibility.
recipe.flightEncoding: SAME occupies the left half of each material column; SAME-R the right. Closed shapes are filled for SAME and open for SAME-R.
recipe.horizontalLayout: Material column plus a flight offset and ((excelRow * 7) % 11 - 5) * 0.023 column widths. Layout only; not data.

interpretation: Visibility changes plotted marks and source-cell counts only; no statistical association is computed or revised. Finite stored channel readings only. Missing/error cells remain in the selected source rows and counts. Different channels have different operators; rows are not independent trials. No fit, alarm classification or prediction.
